resources.string: Use the same session ID on all your devices. Enter an existing ID, generate a new one, or scan the QR code from the desktop app.

Lets approved paired devices view this phone using screenshots on Android 11 and newer, and send taps, gestures and typing during a remote session. Capture starts only when an approved device requests to view and you allow remote control. Protected content cannot be captured. While this phone is locked and an approved device is viewing it, the service also reads the layout of the lock screen: where things are on it, its message line and what its keys say. That lets the viewing device be shown where the pattern, PIN or password is entered. Notifications and anything typed are not read, no app\'s screen is read, and nothing is kept.
